logged_before: any control matching and any spillover or shift outcome
why_not_raw_p452: Wikidata industry (P452) strings split one business into many narrow labels. Exact equality on those strings leaves too few eligible controls. Buckets are the match key.
why_automotive_is_not_its_own_bucket: A bucket that contains only automakers would leave Tesla with almost no non-competitor controls. Automotive industry strings map into consumer_discretionary. Other automakers are removed by the competitor screen, not by the sector key.
ticker_assignment_rule: Each retained ticker is assigned one bucket below before the extract. The assignment follows the GICS-like sector of the listed company. A later Wikidata P452 lookup may be reported against this map. It does not move a ticker after an outcome is computed. A ticker with no bucket is ineligible for matching until a manual bucket is appended here.
unmapped_industry_policy: If a Wikidata industry label is not in this file, the entity stays in its pre-assigned ticker bucket. A new label is added to this map only by a decisions-log entry before matching.

match_bucket_merge.logged_before: any pair count under this rule

groups.name: information_technology_and_communication_services
groups.why: GICS moved Alphabet from information technology to communication services in 2018. A control match for either bucket uses the union of the two control lists. The lists and their names stay as they are. No caliper is widened.
